customManagers.description: Track the distroless runtime's Node major (encoded in the image name) as a Node version so Renovate can bump it; without this it only ever updates the digest, which silently desyncs it from the builder's node:<major> and breaks native-module ABI (better-sqlite3) at runtime.

packageRules.description: Keep the Docker builder Node (node:<major>) and the distroless runtime Node (nodejs<major>) in one PR. Renovate proposes; it does not guarantee: the regex manager's node-version lookup waits for the first LTS-flagged release while the docker and github-releases lookups flip on the schedule date, so this group can open with the runtime missing. tests/unit/node-lockstep.test.ts and the Docker smoke are the gate.

PLATFORM-OPS-005: @types/node majors ride in the node base images PR, because the types major may never exceed the runtime major (tests/unit/node-lockstep.test.ts) and a lone @types/node major PR would be red until the runtime moved.
Auto-merge non-major updates for stable images
Group all minor and patch updates together
Disable auto-merge for major updates - need review
Stability period for minor/patch before auto-merge
